```{r functions}
rmd_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
result_dir <- params$result_dir

if (!dir.exists(result_dir)) {
  result_dir <- file.path(rmd_dir, params$result_dir)
}

contrast_name <- c(
  p10_p00 = "RR",
  p01_p00 = "OR0",
  p11_p10 = "OR1"
)

method_order <- c(
  "gOP_RR", "gOP_OR0", "gOP_OR1",
  "RBC_RR", "RBC_OR0", "RBC_OR1"
)

get_first_value <- function(x, default = NA_real_) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(default)
  x[1]
}

guess_n_from_file <- function(file) {
  base <- basename(file)
  m <- regexpr("n[0-9]+|_[0-9]+", base)
  if (m < 0) return(NA_integer_)
  raw <- regmatches(base, m)
  as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", raw))
}

get_true_beta <- function(measures, contrast) {
  get_first_value(measures$true_log_effect[measures$contrast == contrast])
}

guess_param_set_from_scenario <- function(scenario) {
  out <- sub("^n_?[0-9]+_?", "", scenario)
  out <- sub("^[_-]+", "", out)
  ifelse(nzchar(out), out, NA_character_)
}

read_one_measures <- function(file) {
  measures <- read.csv(file)

  if (!"n" %in% names(measures)) {
    measures$n <- guess_n_from_file(file)
  }
  if (!"scenario" %in% names(measures)) {
    measures$scenario <- sub("^measures_results_?", "", sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(file)))
    measures$scenario[measures$scenario == ""] <- "default"
  }
  if (!"param_set" %in% names(measures)) {
    measures$param_set <- guess_param_set_from_scenario(measures$scenario)
  }
  if (!"b0_true" %in% names(measures)) {
    measures$b0_true <- get_true_beta(measures, "p10_p00")
  }
  if (!"b1_true" %in% names(measures)) {
    measures$b1_true <- get_true_beta(measures, "p01_p00")
  }
  if (!"b2_true" %in% names(measures)) {
    measures$b2_true <- get_true_beta(measures, "p11_p10")
  }

  measures$measure_name <- contrast_name[measures$contrast]
  measures$method_measure <- paste(measures$method, measures$measure_name, sep = "_")
  measures$method_measure <- factor(measures$method_measure, levels = method_order)
  measures$measure_name <- factor(measures$measure_name, levels = c("RR", "OR0", "OR1"))

  measures
}

scenario_label <- function(measures) {
  param_set <- get_first_value(measures$param_set, default = NA_character_)
  param_text <- if (!is.na(param_set) && nzchar(param_set)) {
    paste0(", ", gsub("_", "", param_set))
  } else {
    ""
  }

  paste0(
    "n=", get_first_value(measures$n),
    param_text,
    " (b0=", sprintf("%.2f", get_first_value(measures$b0_true)),
    ", b1=", sprintf("%.2f", get_first_value(measures$b1_true)),
    ", b2=", sprintf("%.2f", get_first_value(measures$b2_true)),
    ")"
  )
}

est.result <- function(df) {
  est <- df$log_estimate
  true <- unique(round(df$true_log_effect, 12))[1]
  se <- df$se
  mcsd <- sd(est, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    n = get_first_value(df$n),
    true = true,
    mean_est = mean(est, na.rm = TRUE),
    bias = mean(est, na.rm = TRUE) - true,
    mean_se = mean(se, na.rm = TRUE),
    mcsd = mcsd,
    se_mcsd = mean(se, na.rm = TRUE) / mcsd,
    coverage = mean(df$ci_low < true & df$ci_up > true, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

summarize_measures <- function(measures) {
  groups <- split(measures, measures$method_measure, drop = TRUE)

  summary_log <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(groups, function(df) {
      data.frame(
        method_measure = df$method_measure[1],
        method = df$method[1],
        contrast = df$contrast[1],
        measure_name = df$measure_name[1],
        est.result(df)
      )
    })
  )

  summary_log$method_measure <- factor(summary_log$method_measure, levels = method_order)
  summary_log$measure_name <- factor(summary_log$measure_name, levels = c("RR", "OR0", "OR1"))
  summary_log <- summary_log[order(summary_log$method_measure), ]
  rownames(summary_log) <- NULL
  summary_log
}

prepare_result <- function(file) {
  measures <- read_one_measures(file)

  list(
    file = file,
    label = scenario_label(measures),
    data = measures,
    summary = summarize_measures(measures)
  )
}

show_input_table <- function(result) {
  measures <- result$data
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(
      scenario = result$label,
      param_set = get_first_value(measures$param_set, default = NA_character_),
      measures_file = basename(result$file),
      n_rows = nrow(measures),
      n_sim = length(unique(measures$sim_id)),
      methods = paste(sort(unique(measures$method)), collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

plot_estimates <- function(result) {
  measures <- result$data
  est_ylim <- c(-4, 4)

  removed_est <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(split(measures, measures$method_measure, drop = TRUE), function(df) {
      data.frame(
        method_measure = df$method_measure[1],
        measure_name = df$measure_name[1],
        n_hi = sum(!is.na(df$log_estimate) & df$log_estimate > est_ylim[2]),
        n_lo = sum(!is.na(df$log_estimate) & df$log_estimate < est_ylim[1])
      )
    })
  )

  true_lines <- unique(measures[, c("measure_name", "true_log_effect")])
  need_truncate <- any(removed_est$n_hi > 0 | removed_est$n_lo > 0)

  p <- ggplot(measures, aes(x = method_measure, y = log_estimate, fill = method_measure)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "grey20", width = 0.8, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(
      data = true_lines,
      aes(yintercept = true_log_effect),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "steelblue"
    ) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 1.5,
                 fill = "white", color = "black") +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(removed_est, n_hi > 0),
      aes(x = method_measure, y = est_ylim[2], label = n_hi),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4,
      color = "blue"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(removed_est, n_lo > 0),
      aes(x = method_measure, y = est_ylim[1], label = n_lo),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4,
      color = "blue"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(removed_est, n_hi > 0),
      aes(x = method_measure, y = est_ylim[2], size = n_hi),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "red",
      color = "red",
      alpha = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(removed_est, n_lo > 0),
      aes(x = method_measure, y = est_ylim[1], size = n_lo),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "red",
      color = "red",
      alpha = 0.55
    ) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 20) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~ measure_name, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Monte Carlo distributions of log-scale estimates (", result$label, ")"),
      x = "Method_measure",
      y = "Estimated log effect"
    )

  if (requireNamespace("ggsci", quietly = TRUE)) {
    p <- p + ggsci::scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20")
  }

  if (need_truncate) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = est_ylim)
  }

  p
}

plot_se <- function(result) {
  measures <- result$data
  se_ylim <- c(0, 4)

  removed_se <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(split(measures, measures$method_measure, drop = TRUE), function(df) {
      data.frame(
        method_measure = df$method_measure[1],
        measure_name = df$measure_name[1],
        removed = sum(is.na(df$se) | !is.finite(df$se) | df$se >= se_ylim[2])
      )
    })
  )

  se_plot <- measures[is.finite(measures$se), ]
  need_truncate <- any(is.finite(measures$se) & measures$se > se_ylim[2])

  p <- ggplot(se_plot, aes(x = method_measure, y = se, fill = method_measure)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "grey20", width = 0.8, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 1.5,
                 fill = "white", color = "black") +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(removed_se, removed > 0),
      aes(x = method_measure, y = se_ylim[2], label = removed),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4,
      color = "blue"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(removed_se, removed > 0),
      aes(x = method_measure, y = se_ylim[2], size = removed),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "red",
      color = "red",
      alpha = 0.55
    ) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 20) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~ measure_name, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Monte Carlo distributions of standard errors (", result$label, ")"),
      x = "Method_measure",
      y = "Estimated SE"
    )

  if (requireNamespace("ggsci", quietly = TRUE)) {
    p <- p + ggsci::scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20")
  }

  if (need_truncate) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = se_ylim)
  }

  p
}

plot_lollipop <- function(result, value, target, title, ylab, truncate_ylim = NULL) {
  df <- result$summary
  df$dev <- abs(df[[value]] - target)
  df$label_y <- ifelse(df[[value]] >= target, df[[value]] + 0.012, df[[value]] - 0.012)
  df$vjust <- ifelse(df[[value]] >= target, 0, 1)

  dynamic_ylim <- range(c(df$label_y, df[[value]], target), finite = TRUE)
  dynamic_ylim <- c(dynamic_ylim[1] - 0.02, dynamic_ylim[2] + 0.02)

  need_truncate <- !is.null(truncate_ylim) &&
    any(is.finite(df[[value]]) &
          (df[[value]] < truncate_ylim[1] | df[[value]] > truncate_ylim[2]))

  ylim <- if (need_truncate) truncate_ylim else dynamic_ylim

  ggplot(df, aes(x = method_measure, y = .data[[value]])) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = method_measure, y = target, yend = .data[[value]], color = dev),
      linewidth = 3,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = label_y, label = sprintf("%.3f", .data[[value]]), vjust = vjust),
      size = 4
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = target, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = method_order, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "red4") +
    guides(color = "none") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Method_measure",
      y = ylab
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim, clip = "off")
}

measure_files <- list.files(
  result_dir,
  pattern = "^measures_results.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
measure_files <- measure_files[!grepl("analysis|summary", basename(measure_files))]
measure_files <- sort(measure_files)

results <- lapply(measure_files, prepare_result)
names(results) <- vapply(results, `[[`, character(1), "label")
all_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(results, function(x) {
    cbind(scenario = x$label, file = basename(x$file), x$summary)
  })
)
rownames(all_summary) <- NULL
```

small_3: (0.08, 0.12, 0.16, 0.20)

```{r scenarios}
scenario_info <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(results, function(x) {
    data.frame(
      scenario = x$label,
      param_set = get_first_value(x$data$param_set, default = NA_character_),
      file = basename(x$file),
      n_rows = nrow(x$data),
      n_sim = length(unique(x$data$sim_id)),
      methods = paste(sort(unique(x$data$method)), collapse = ", ")
    )
  })
)

knitr::kable(scenario_info)
```


# Scenario Figures

```{r scenario-figures, results='asis'}
for (result in results) {
  cat("\n\n## ", result$label, "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(show_input_table(result))

  cat("\n\n### Log-Scale Summary\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(result$summary, digits = 4))

  cat("\n\n### Point Estimates\n\n")
  print(plot_estimates(result))

  cat("\n\n### Standard Errors\n\n")
  print(plot_se(result))

  cat("\n\n### SE / MCSD\n\n")
  print(plot_lollipop(
    result,
    value = "se_mcsd",
    target = 1,
    title = paste0("Mean SE / Monte Carlo SD by method_measure (", result$label, ")"),
    ylab = "Mean SE / MCSD",
    truncate_ylim = c(0, 2)
  ))

  cat("\n\n### Coverage\n\n")
  print(plot_lollipop(
    result,
    value = "coverage",
    target = 0.95,
    title = paste0("Empirical coverage rates of 95% confidence intervals (", result$label, ")"),
    ylab = "Coverage rate"
  ))
}
```
